title: London-based e-commerce logistics platform Swap raised a $100M Series C led by DST Global and Iconiq, after raising a $40M Series B in March 2025 (Axios)
summary: Axios: London-based e-commerce logistics platform Swap raised a $100M Series C led by DST Global and Iconiq, after raising a $40M Series B in March 2025 — Swap, a London-based e-commerce logistics platform, raised a $100 million Series C led by DST Global and Iconiq.
